scope: 24 chronological source/result pose pairs and the native 3.37-second comparison; full 180-frame border scan is separate mechanical evidence.
observations: Cross-steps, forward reaches, body turn, knee lift and overhead/head-wrap phases correspond in the inspected poses.
Character face, blonde/pink curled hair, pink top, denim shorts and sneakers remain recognizable.
Hands are more proportionate than the Wan output on the same driving clip, but fine finger contours are simplified and occasionally merged.
The .45 Kling plate produced actual sneaker clipping; changing only body_fill to 0.4 produced this take with a clear 180-frame border scan. This single controlled case is not a success-rate estimate.

all_frame_framing_aid.definition: per-frame max RGB channel distance >20 from median of four8x8 corner patches; corners agree within8
all_frame_framing_aid.scope: Pixel foreground union over all 180 native frames, for static crop authoring only; no anatomy or motion certification.

limitations: Source gesture heights and leg bends are approximated.
A plain studio background does not establish exact foot-floor contact.
Sampled poses do not certify every transition or unseen choreography.
This producer note is not publication approval; a separate independent content review is required.
